video_dataset.name: Layer B Real-World Train Passage Evaluation Dataset
video_dataset.note: The previous real-world evaluation media was intentionally retired before ingestion of a replacement evaluation dataset.

audio_dataset.name: Train Horn Audio Model Development Dataset

data_separation_rules: Dataset V1 remains the YOLO development/training dataset.
The replacement Layer B real-world evaluation dataset remains an unseen evaluation dataset.
The standalone horn recordings are for audio-model development.
Embedded audio from real-world test videos must not be mixed into audio training before evaluation.
No new real-world test video frames may be added to YOLO training before evaluation.
No test-event information may leak into training.
